concepts.title: Hash Frequency Mapping & Collision Handling
concepts.description: Using hash tables to achieve O(1) average lookup for element frequencies, duplicates, and complement matching.

concepts.title: Prefix Sum & Subarray Invariant
concepts.description: Transforming range queries and contiguous subarray problems into constant-time prefix sum difference checks.

concepts.title: Two Pointers Convergence & Monotonicity
concepts.description: Exploiting sorted arrays or structural bounds to move left and right pointers inward based on monotonic conditions.

concepts.title: Fast & Slow Pointer Cycle Detection
concepts.description: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm for detecting cycles and finding middle nodes without extra space.

concepts.title: Sliding Window Invariant & Shrink Condition
concepts.description: Maintaining a dynamic contiguous subarray window and dynamically shrinking the left boundary when invalid invariants occur.

concepts.title: Fixed-Size Window Rolling Computation
concepts.description: Rolling a fixed-length window across array/string by adding incoming element and removing outgoing element in O(1).

concepts.title: Monotonic Stack Next Greater/Smaller Boundary
concepts.description: Maintaining a monotonic increasing/decreasing stack to identify contiguous span boundaries and next/previous greater/smaller elements.

concepts.title: Stack Parenthesis & Expression Invariant
concepts.description: Using LIFO stack ordering to enforce nested structure matching, operator precedence, and undo state evaluation.

concepts.title: Binary Search Monotonic Search Space Mapping
concepts.description: Halving search space by evaluating monotonic predicate functions, including searching on answer ranges.

concepts.title: Rotated Sorted Array Pivot Isolation
concepts.description: Identifying sorted halves in rotated arrays to decide left vs right search space reduction.

concepts.title: Linked List In-Place Pointer Manipulation
concepts.description: Direct pointer assignment, dummy head nodes, and multi-pointer swaps without allocating extra list nodes.

concepts.title: Tree Post-Order State Passing & Depth Invariant
concepts.description: Bubbling up sub-tree heights, diameters, or validity flags in post-order traversal to combine child states into parent decisions.

concepts.title: BST Range Constraint Validation
concepts.description: Propagating min/max value bounds down binary search trees to validate structural search properties.

concepts.title: Trie Prefix Tree Traversal & Word Boundary
concepts.description: Character-by-character tree navigation for prefix lookup, autocomplete, and wild-card pattern matching.

concepts.title: Heap Top-K Element Tracking & Dynamic Rebalancing
concepts.description: Maintaining min/max heaps of size K to continuously track k-th extremums or dual-heap median balancing.

concepts.title: Backtracking Choice Space & Pruning Invariant
concepts.description: Systematic search tree exploration with append, recurse, and pop backtrack steps, pruned by constraint checks.

concepts.title: Graph DFS Cycle Detection & State Marking
concepts.description: 3-state coloring (unvisited, visiting, visited) during depth-first traversal to catch back-edges and directed cycles.

concepts.title: Graph BFS Unweighted Shortest Path & Level Order
concepts.description: Queue-driven level-by-level traversal guaranteeing minimal edge count distance in unweighted graphs or grids.

concepts.title: Union-Find Disjoint Set Path Compression
concepts.description: Near constant time dynamic connectivity tracking using parent array pointers, rank optimization, and path compression.

concepts.title: Topological Sort Indegree Reduction (Kahn's Algo)
concepts.description: Processing zero-indegree nodes sequentially in DAGs to compute linear execution ordering and dependency resolution.

concepts.title: DP State Definition & Dimension Allocation
concepts.description: Defining optimal subproblem state representations (e.g. dp[i], dp[i][j]) that satisfy the Bellman optimality principle.

concepts.title: DP Recurrence Formulation & Transition Logic
concepts.description: Formulating exact mathematical transitions between subproblem states based on decisions made at step i.

concepts.title: Recognizing Overlapping Subproblems & Memoization
concepts.description: Caching recursive calls or tabulating sub-computations to eliminate exponential re-computation of subtrees.

concepts.title: Greedy Choice Local Optimality & Exchange Proof
concepts.description: Making locally optimal choices at each step that provably lead to globally optimal solutions without backtracking.

concepts.title: Interval Sorting by Start/End & Overlap Invariant
concepts.description: Sorting interval tuples by start/end coordinates to sequentially resolve merges, insertions, and overlaps.

concepts.title: Bitwise XOR Cancellation & Mask Manipulation
concepts.description: Using XOR properties (x ^ x = 0, x ^ 0 = x), bitwise AND/OR masks, and bit shifting for O(1) space operations.

concepts.title: Matrix In-Place Rotation & Boundary Simulation
concepts.description: Simulating matrix operations (rotation, spiral traversal, zeroing) using 2D coordinate transformation invariants.
